newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: Court says Commission has duty to protect bank's privacy.
newsitem.headline: Court says Commission has duty to protect bank's privacy.

text.p: The European Court of First Instance annulled a Commission decision on Wednesday which allowed information presented during administrative Commission hearings by one concern to be used by third parties.

The Dutch Association of Banks (NVB) participated in an administrative hearing with the Commisison in 1991 and at the hearing, modified its pricing system. As a result of the changes, many complaints were lodged against certain banks, including Postbank.

The Commission decided in 1994 third parties could use information presented at the Commission hearing before national courts. Postbank challenged the decision, arguing information presented at the hearing about Postbank was sensitive and should not be released for public record.
The court supported Postbank and said the Commission misjudged its obligation to keep confidential documents and information presented at administrative hearings.
(Court translation into French. Original language of the case: Dutch)

"Concurrence - Procedure administrative - Communication des griefs et proces-verbal de l'audition - Decision par laquelle la Commission a admis la production de ces document, par des tiers a la procedure administrative, dans le cadre de procedures judiciaires nationales - Acte susceptible de recours - Secret professionel - Secret professionnel - Secrets d'affaires"
Commission des Communautes europeennes, partie defenderesse

ayant pour objet une demande d'annulation de la decision de la Commission, contenue dans ses lettres du 23 septembre 1994 et du 3/4 octobre 1994 et admettant que des entreprises tierces produisent, dans le cadre de procedures judiciares nationales, la communication des griefs et le proces-verbal de l'audition, que la Commission leur a transmis pendant unde procedure administrative
LA TRIBUNAL DE PREMIERE INSTANCE declare et arrete

1. La decision de Commission, contenue dans ses lettres du 23 septembre 1994 et du 3/4 octobre 1994, adressees aux entreprises NUON Veluwse Nutsbedrijven NV et Maatschappij Elektriciteit en Gas Limburg NV, est annulee.
2. La Commission est condamnee aux depens.
